accounting.metric: sum of own allocated model-worker GPU durations across devices; include model loading, saves, failures and retries
accounting.transfers: none; independent of every prior window
accounting.worker_stop_rule: a worker claims no new slot once charged GPU-h exceeds 380.0

authorization.basis: 30 training cells + 30 learned and 12 zero-shot evaluation cells on P2+P2u; ~227 GPU-h expected, ~325 at the 2R cap

execution_authorization: protocol committed before any derivation; membership and panels committed before any control or training; code and job files committed before their first launch; no outcome-selected variants; independent replay of every episode
